review_scope: Focused semantic terminology amendment: Chinese chapter label 付出、责任与亏欠 and source titles/decks for essays 16–20, including all occurrences of 亏欠 in their source body paragraphs, compared with the German index fourth chapter and all five German chapter metadata fields. This amendment does not claim a new full prose review.
rationale: Adding das Gefühl restricts indebtedness to a subjective feeling, whereas the source also discusses actual obligations arising from harm and debts that compensation cannot fully settle. The replacement denotes what one owes others without reducing it to a feeling, implying financial debt only, or adding reciprocal obligation.
